messages.subject_clean: R companion to Sampling 3rd Ed by STEVEN K. THOMPSON
messages.body_plain:
Dear All:


I am teaching Sampling Methods course this Fall 2026 semester. I am using
the textbook


Sampling 3rd ed by STEVEN K. THOMPSON.


I am wondering if someone knows if there exists an R companion to this
textbook.


If there is no R companion for this book, does someone have R
codes/functions written specifically for this textbook? It would be highly
appreciated if you send me a copy of these R codes/functions.



Thank you very much for your attention to this matter.


With many thanks

Abou


______________________
AbouEl-Makarim Aboueissa,  PhD

Professor, Mathematics and Statistics

University of Southern Maine


______________________
